text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — overnight we saw a 503 spike on the ingestion endpoint that affected a subset of onboarding customers. Need a concise customer-facing status + RCA note, office hours, and a credit offer. Who can own? :wave:

devops_bot: Alert: 503-rate-spike detected 2026-03-22T04:12Z -> 04:40Z. Peak error rate 18% for /v1/embeddings/ingest. Autoscaler triggered fallback to smaller pool at 04:18Z.

jordan_se: I can own the external brief. I'll draft a 3-paragraph message: what happened, what's fixed, next steps + invite to office hours.

lee_support: Adding affected tenant list to the thread: `risky_accounts.csv` (shared in #private-cs-docs). Main high-touch ones: Acme, BloomOps, NimbusAI, LatticePulse.

jordan_se: Draft 1 below, please quick-edit: 

```
Hi <customer>,

We experienced transient ingestion errors on March 22 that impacted a subset of onboarding imports. Root cause: an autoscaler edge-case that routed some requests to a scaled-down pool during a traffic burst, causing intermittent 503s. Mitigation: we reverted the autoscaler policy and applied a targeted capacity bump at 04:25Z; errors returned to baseline by 04:40Z.

What we're doing next: proactive tenant re-ingest, dedicated office hours, and a credit offer for affected imports. We'll share a detailed RCA within 48 hours and a postmortem in your tenant portal.

If you'd like live help, join office hours on March 23 14:00 PT — RSVP link: https://go.redwood/office-hours

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success
```

sam_ce: Looks good. Suggest adding explicit timeline bullets and whether any customer data was lost (explicit statement).

jordan_se: Updated draft: added bullets and a clear "no data loss" line. Pinging @lisa_legal for wording sign-off on credits.

lisa_legal: Quick read — credit language ok but add a clause: credits issued within 7 business days after acceptance, non-transferable. Also confirm the SLA band this falls under.

maria_cs: Thanks all. Action items: Jordan finalize and send by EOD, Lee confirm affected list and tenant contact emails, Sam coordinate office hours hosts (prod + infra), Lisa stamp legal by 3pm. I'll prepare CS exec note for shared customers.

lee_support: Affected list + emails posted to private doc. Also added tenant-specific notes for Acme & NimbusAI (both flagged as high-risk renewals).

jordan_se: Sending message batch for high-touch tomorrow AM and broader note to self-serve tenants later. I'll include an embedded survey link for feedback and a short follow-up checklist: re-ingest status + contact assigned.

sam_ce: Office hours host roster: me + infra lead @ryan_infra + eng-oncall. I'll create the calendar invite and RSVP tracker.

maria_cs: Great. After send, let's capture responses in the tracker and escalate any renewal-risk replies to me directly. We'll include a short CSAT pulse in the follow-up. :+1:

devops_bot: Note: autoscaler fix deployed 2026-03-22T05:02Z. Monitoring nominal.

jordan_se: Sent to high-touch list at 09:02AM. Copy of outbound posted to #private-cs-docs. Will circle back with final RCA draft within 36 hours.

maria_cs: Thanks — keeping this thread as the canonical ops brief. If anyone gets priority replies, mention me and I'll join the convo.
